newsitem.title: USA: Tractor to open fewer stores than planned.
newsitem.headline: Tractor to open fewer stores than planned.

text.p: Tractor Supply Co said Thursday it plans to open six new stores in fiscal 1997 rather than the nine it had planned and that it would open about 18 new stores in 1998, rather than the 28 originally planned.
It said it also plans to close two stores in the third quarter of fiscal 1997.
Tractor said the opening of fewer new stores in 1998 will help it focus efforts on rejuvenating the merchandise mix and improving comparable store sales.
It said it currently expects to resume its approximate 12 percent overall new store unit growth rate each year beginning in fiscal 1999.
On Thursday, the company reported second quarter earnings of $0.80 a share, down from $0.90 a share in the 1996 quarter.
The company said it is continuing to take steps to rejuvenate its merchandise mix by accelerating the rate of change in our product offerings and making certain management changes.
